text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet takes the crown in the Oka 
Sho. Aston Machan was defeated, but she 
smiles as the spectators praise her 
running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race, Aston Machan gazes 
contentedly at the spectators before 
leaving behind a curious mutter: "This is 
as far as Machan goes..."
